target_contracts.positive: forall n : Nat, fib (-(Int.ofNat n)) = if Even (Int.ofNat n) then -fib (Int.ofNat n) else fib (Int.ofNat n)
target_contracts.negative: forall k : Nat, fib (-(Int.negSucc k)) = if Even (Int.negSucc k) then -fib (Int.negSucc k) else fib (Int.negSucc k)

residual_parameters: positivePresentation : forall n, fibFn (Int.ofNat n) = Int.ofNat (natFib n)
negativeEven : forall n, n % 2 = 0 -> fibFn (-(Int.ofNat n)) = -Int.ofNat (natFib n)
negativeOdd : forall n, n % 2 = 1 -> fibFn (-(Int.ofNat n)) = Int.ofNat (natFib n)
modCases : forall n, n % 2 = 0 or n % 2 = 1
evenPositive : forall n, Even (Int.ofNat n) iff n % 2 = 0
evenNegative : forall n, Even (-(Int.ofNat n)) iff n % 2 = 0
proof_method: Case on modCases. Rewrite each exact Even conditional with the matching directional parity contract; use positivePresentation plus negativeEven/negativeOdd. In the negative constructor branch, reduce Int.negSucc k to -(Int.ofNat (k+1)) and use negNeg only in the even case.
stop_rule: Any construction, project-root staging, elaboration, export, determinism, or audit failure stops without retry or theorem/ledger authority.
next_on_accept: Qualify each concrete support contract in existing clean capsules, compose the branch residuals, specialize exact branches, then specialize the clean outer residual to Int.fib.
limitations: Parameterized branch residuals alone establish neither concrete branch nor exact Int.fib_neg.
